metaDescription: Framer is a no-code website builder with a design canvas, AI agents, CMS, localization and hosting. See its features, site plans, editor pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: Framer is a no-code website builder for designers and marketing teams. You design pages on a free-form visual canvas, with components, breakpoints and styles, and publish them as fast, server-rendered websites without handing the work to an engineer.

Hosting, a CMS, SEO controls, analytics and localization are built in, and AI agents can generate, edit and translate pages while keeping everything editable on the canvas. Framer is built for websites: it isn't a design file tool for app interfaces, and it doesn't generate application code. Plans are priced per site, with a free plan for publishing on a Framer domain.

features.title: Visual canvas
features.text: Design responsive pages with components, breakpoints and styles, then publish directly from the canvas.

features.title: AI agents
features.text: Generate, edit and maintain pages with AI. Every plan includes monthly AI credits.

features.title: Built-in CMS
features.text: Collections for articles, careers, events or directories, with conditional visibility based on content.

features.title: Localization
features.text: Translate pages and CMS content manually or with AI, with locale-specific slugs and redirects.

features.title: SEO and performance
features.text: Server-rendered pages with metadata, sitemaps and structured data; redirects on the Pro plan.

features.title: Hosting and analytics
features.text: Managed hosting and built-in analytics, plus staging and branch previews on the Pro plan.

useCases: CMS-driven blogs, directories and careers pages
strengths: Design and publish from one visual canvas, without a developer handoff.
Hosting, CMS, SEO controls and analytics are included in one platform.
Built-in localization, with AI translation that keeps locales in sync as you edit.
A free plan lets you build and publish a site on a Framer domain.
limitations: Free sites use a Framer domain and show a “Made in Framer” banner; a custom domain needs a paid plan.
Each site needs its own plan, and extra editors cost $20/mo each (the workspace owner is free).
The Basic plan includes only 2 CMS collections; Pro raises this to 10.
Some features are paid add-ons, including localization on Basic, A/B testing and advanced hosting.
Built for websites — not for app interface design files or generating application code.

pricing.summary: Free plan; paid plans are priced per site. The workspace owner is free, extra editors cost $20/mo and Content Editors $10/mo, and viewers are free.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: Framer domain · 1 GB bandwidth · “Made in Framer” banner · 500 AI credits/mo

plans.name: Basic
plans.note: Billed yearly · custom domain · 2 CMS collections · 50 GB bandwidth · localization add-on

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: 10 CMS collections · 100 GB bandwidth · redirects · staging · branch previews

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Unlimited editors · SSO and SCIM · uptime guarantee · custom limits
